title: Factory utilities
description: The reference factory: four production lines served by compressed air, chilled water and power, composed only from the built-in library, with the air and cooling loops closed by sampled ports.
stresses: coupled utility subsystems whose faults look alike across subsystems: air leaks against airend wear, tower fan failure against a heat wave, a stale main meter against its sub-meters

profiles.name: nominal
profiles.description: A production day of the factory, one fault per scenario.

profiles.name: sensor_pathology
profiles.description: An instrument lies while the process is healthy.

profiles.name: correlated_cascade
profiles.description: A utility fault spreads through the links: low header pressure slows every line, a weak tower warms the chilled water every line and the air handler draw on.
